source_title: Auqib Nabi set to play full ODI series vs New Zealand, replaces injured Prasidh Krishna - India Today
source_excerpt:
Fast bowler Auqib Nabi has been moved into India's squad for the first three ODIs against New Zealand, making him part of the group for the entire five-match series. He steps in after Prasidh Krishna was ruled out with a hamstring injury, with the India pacer now focused on recovering for the Tests.
Jammu and Kashmir pacer Auqib Nabi has been added to India's squad for the first three ODIs against New Zealand, bringing him into the squad for the entire five-match series. Nabi was initially named in the squad for the fourth and fifth matches, but the Men’s Selection Committee has now moved him into the group from the start of the series.
Nabi's promotion comes after India speedster Prasidh Krishna was ruled out of the ODI series due to a hamstring injury. Prasidh has not fully recovered from the injury he sustained during the second ODI against the West Indies in Guwahati, where he managed one wicket for 45 runs in five overs before leaving the field.
The 30-year-old was initially named in India's ODI squad subject to fitness. However, with the team management keen to have him fully fit for the upcoming Test series, Prasidh will not travel for the 50-over assignments.
Nabi had emerged as a possible replacement after impressing during India A's red-ball series against New Zealand A. His three-wicket burst in the first unofficial Test at Lincoln, along with the seam movement he generated, caught the attention of touring selectors Pragyan Ojha and Ajay Ratra.
INDIA'S UPDATED ODI SQUAD FOR FIRST 3 MATCHES
With Nabi moving into the squad for the first three matches, India's updated group will be led by Shubman Gill, with Shreyas Iyer serving as vice-captain. The squad also includes Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, KL Rahul, Ruturaj Gaikwad and Ishan Kishan.
India's updated squad for the first three ODIs:
Shubman Gill (captain), Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer (vice-captain), KL Rahul (wicketkeeper), Axar Patel, Naman Dhir, Anshul Kamboj, Gurnoor Brar, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Arshdeep Singh, Ishan Kishan (wicketkeeper), Mohammed Siraj, Kuldeep Yadav, Nitish Kumar Reddy (first ODI only) and Auqib Nabi.
Nabi will also remain part of the squad for the fourth and fifth ODIs. The squad for the final two matches will be led by Iyer, with Tilak Varma and Kumar Kushagra among the players included for that leg of the series. PRASIDH'S FOCUS SHIFTS TO TEST SERIES
Prasidh's absence is a setback for India's ODI plans, but the team management is understood to be prioritising his recovery for the Test series. The pacer played a significant role in India's drawn series in England, finishing with 32 wickets in nine Tests and making an impact in the final match at The Oval.
India have a relatively inexperienced pace attack for the ODI series. Arshdeep Singh, Anshul Kamboj and Nabi will have limited international experience between them, while Mohammed Siraj is the only frontline pacer in the group with more than 50 ODI appearances. Jasprit Bumrah has been rested from the series to focus on the Tests.
The five-match ODI series against New Zealand begins on November 4. - Ends
hi_body:
तेज़ गेंदबाज Auqib Nabi को न्यूजीलैंड के खिलाफ पहले तीन एकदिवसीय मैचों के लिए भारत की टीम में शामिल कर लिया गया है, जिससे वह पांच मैचों की पूरी श्रृंखला के लिए टीम का हिस्सा बन गए हैं। रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, Nabi को Prasidh Krishna के चोटिल होने के कारण टीम में शामिल किया गया है, जो हैमस्ट्रिंग की चोट के कारण श्रृंखला से बाहर हो गए हैं।

पुरुष चयन समिति के अपडेट के अनुसार, Nabi को मूल रूप से केवल चौथे और पांचवें मैच के लिए टीम में चुना गया था। हालांकि, प्रसिद्ध के हटने के बाद अब उन्हें श्रृंखला की शुरुआत से ही टीम में शामिल कर लिया गया है।

## चोट का अपडेट और चयन संदर्भ

प्रसिद्ध कृष्णा को गुवाहाटी में वेस्टइंडीज के खिलाफ दूसरे वनडे के दौरान हैमस्ट्रिंग में चोट लगी थी। हालांकि 30 वर्षीय तेज गेंदबाज को शुरुआत में फिटनेस के अधीन भारतीय वनडे टीम में नामित किया गया था, लेकिन टीम प्रबंधन आगामी टेस्ट श्रृंखला के लिए उनकी रिकवरी को प्राथमिकता दे रहा है, इसलिए वह 50 ओवर के मैचों के दौरे पर नहीं जाएंगे।

Nabi ने न्यूजीलैंड ए के खिलाफ भारत ए की लाल गेंद की श्रृंखला के दौरान अपने प्रभावशाली प्रदर्शन के बाद जगह बनाई, जहां लिंकन में पहले अनौपचारिक टेस्ट में उनके तीन विकेट और सीम मूवमेंट ने चयनकर्ताओं प्रज्ञान ओझा और अजय रात्रा का ध्यान आकर्षित किया।

## पहले तीन वनडे के लिए भारत की अद्यतन टीम

* शुभमन गिल (कप्तान)
* श्रेयस अय्यर (उपकप्तान)
* रोहित शर्मा
* विराट कोहली
* केएल राहुल (विकेटकीपर)
* इशान किशन (विकेटकीपर)
* रुतुराज गायकवाड़
* अक्षर पटेल
* नमन धीर
* अंशुल कंबोज
* गुरनूर ब्रार
* अर्शदीप सिंह
* मोहम्मद सिराज
* कुलदीप यादव
* नीतीश कुमार रेड्डी (केवल पहला वनडे)
* Auqib Nabi

Nabi श्रृंखला के अंतिम दो मैचों के लिए भी टीम का हिस्सा बने रहेंगे। न्यूजीलैंड के खिलाफ पांच मैचों की एकदिवसीय श्रृंखला 4 नवंबर से शुरू होने वाली है। प्रशंसक भारतीय क्रिकेट कंट्रोल बोर्ड (BCCI) के आधिकारिक चैनलों और अधिकृत प्रसारण साझेदारों के माध्यम से आधिकारिक टीम घोषणाओं और मैच के समय की पुष्टि कर सकते हैं।

en_body:
Fast bowler Auqib Nabi has been added to India's squad for the first three ODIs against New Zealand, ensuring his participation in the entire five-match series. Reports indicate that Nabi steps in following an injury to Prasidh Krishna, who has been ruled out due to a hamstring injury.

According to the Men’s Selection Committee updates, Nabi was originally named in the squad solely for the fourth and fifth matches. However, he has now been shifted into the group from the beginning of the series following Prasidh's withdrawal.

## Injury Update and Selection Context

Prasidh Krishna sustained a hamstring injury during the second ODI against the West Indies in Guwahati. Although initially named in India's ODI squad subject to fitness, the 30-year-old pacer will not travel for the 50-over assignments as the team management prioritizes his recovery for the upcoming Test series.

Nabi earned his place following impressive performances for India A during their red-ball series against New Zealand A, where his seam movement and a three-wicket burst in the first unofficial Test at Lincoln caught the attention of touring selectors Pragyan Ojha and Ajay Ratra.

## India's Updated Squad for the First Three ODIs

* Shubman Gill (Captain)
* Shreyas Iyer (Vice-Captain)
* Rohit Sharma
* Virat Kohli
* KL Rahul (Wicketkeeper)
* Ishan Kishan (Wicketkeeper)
* Ruturaj Gaikwad
* Axar Patel
* Naman Dhir
* Anshul Kamboj
* Gurnoor Brar
* Arshdeep Singh
* Mohammed Siraj
* Kuldeep Yadav
* Nitish Kumar Reddy (First ODI only)
* Auqib Nabi

Nabi will remain with the squad for the final two matches of the series as well. The five-match ODI series against New Zealand is scheduled to begin on November 4. Fans can verify official squad announcements and match timings through the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) official channels and authorized broadcast partners.
